title: opportuniTY search consistency and pipeline
description: The SLO-driving signals of baseline §7, §21, §26 and §28 (E19-T05): commit to searchable, watermark, outbox, queues, index tasks, jobs, search latency, WAL archiving and OpenSearch. Metric catalog and alert runbooks: docs/operations/metrics.md and docs/operations/alerts.md.

panels.title: Interactive commit → searchable p95
panels.description: §17: < 1 s (alert InteractiveCommitToSearchableSlow).

panels.title: Security projection lag p95
panels.description: Q-10: ≤ 5 s (alert SecurityProjectionLagHigh).

panels.title: Index lag (worst workspace)
panels.description: §26: bulk ≤ 2 min (alert BulkIndexLagHigh).

panels.title: Outbox oldest age
panels.description: ADR-001: ≤ 60 s (alert OutboxOldestAgeHigh).

panels.title: Dead-lettered / parked messages
panels.description: 0 (alert DeadLetterQueueNotEmpty).

panels.title: WAL archive age
panels.description: RPO ≤ 5 min; alerts above 4 min while WAL is written (WalArchiveLagHigh). Empty without archiving.

panels.title: Commit → searchable p95 by lane
panels.description: opportunity.search.commit_to_searchable: interactive < 1 s, bulk < 2 min.

panels.title: Security projection lag p95 by lane
panels.description: opportunity.search.security_projection_lag (Q-10 ≤ 5 s).

panels.title: Index lag by workspace
panels.description: Age of the oldest committed change not yet searchable (top workspaces + other).

panels.title: Generations behind the watermark by workspace
panels.description: opportunity.search.generation.lag = committed − indexed (§28). Must fall back to 0 (alert SearchWatermarkStuck).

panels.title: Committed vs indexed generation
panels.description: Per workspace (bounded).

panels.title: Stale-version rejections per second
panels.description: OpenSearch external-version conflicts treated as no-ops (ADR-001 §3): expected under concurrent edits; a sustained rise means duplicate or reordered work.

panels.title: Commit → broker confirm p95
panels.description: opportunity.outbox.publish_latency (outbox p95 < 100 ms at idle).

panels.title: Published per second
panels.description: unconfirmed = the broker did not confirm; the row is retried.

panels.title: Unacknowledged messages by queue
panels.description: Delivered to a consumer and not yet acknowledged (rabbitmq_prometheus /metrics/detailed): in-flight work.

panels.title: Dead-letter and parking queues
panels.description: > 0 alerts; inspect the PostgreSQL copies (jobs dlq list), purge once settled.

panels.title: Consumers by queue
panels.description: 0 on an index lane alerts (IndexQueueWithoutConsumers).

panels.title: Dead letters recorded per second
panels.description: opportunity.dlq.messages by queue and reason.

panels.title: Index tasks by status
panels.description: IndexChunkTasks not yet Applied (Failed alerts: IndexChunkTasksFailed).

panels.title: Oldest index task by status
panels.description: Running: since the lease began (≥ 15 min alerts); other statuses: since commit.

panels.title: Index task attempts per second
panels.description: retry and failed outcomes are chunk retries.

panels.title: Bulk items per second
panels.description: Documents written by _bulk: applied, stale, transient, permanent.

panels.title: Oldest open job chunk
panels.description: Running ≥ 15 min alerts (JobChunkRunningTooLong).

panels.title: Job chunk outcomes per second
panels.description: retry = chunk retries; failed alerts (JobChunksFailed).

panels.title: Search latency by class
panels.description: §17: simple p95 < 1 s, complex p95 < 3 s (alert SearchLatencyHigh).

panels.title: Hits dropped by the page re-check
panels.description: Q-12 per-page PostgreSQL re-check; a rise follows security lag.

panels.title: WAL archive age
panels.description: Seconds since the last WAL segment was archived (postgres_exporter stat_archiver). RPO ≤ 5 min.

panels.title: Replication lag
panels.description: On standbys only (replication collector).

panels.title: Rows changed per second
panels.description: Write activity; WAL archiving is expected while this is above 0.

panels.title: Heap used
panels.description: Above 90 % for 15 min alerts (OpenSearchHeapHigh).

panels.title: Thread pool rejections per second
panels.description: write rejections alert (OpenSearchBulkRejections); index workers back off and retry.
